tagline: Lakhon sensors ke liye chhote publish/subscribe messages.
description: MQTT devices ko ek central broker ke zariye jodta hai. Sensors home/kitchen/temp jaise topics par messages publish karte hain, aur jo bhi matching topic par subscribed hai use copy mil jaati hai. Headers sirf 2 bytes ke ho sakte hain, aur QoS, retained messages aur last wills jaise features ise kamzor networks ke liye fit banate hain.

normal.name: Sensor, broker aur dashboard
normal.summary: Will ke saath CONNECT, wildcards ke saath SUBSCRIBE, ek retained value, QoS 1 publishing, pings, aur will ka fire hona.

steps.title: Sensor CONNECT bhejta hai
steps.desc: Client ID, keep alive, login aur last will
steps.detail: Ek chhota temperature sensor port 1883 par broker se connect hota hai. Uska CONNECT kehta hai: protocol MQTT level 4 (3.1.1), keep alive 60 s, client ID livingroom-sensor, username aur password, aur last will: agar main gayab ho jaun, to home/livingroom/status par "offline" publish karo. Broker return code 0 ke saath CONNACK se jawab deta hai.
facts: 0xEE: user, pass, will retain, will QoS 1, will, clean

quiz.q: CONNECT ka pehla byte 0x10 hai. Uske do halves ka kya matlab hai?
quiz.why: High 4 bits packet type hain (1 = CONNECT). Low 4 bits flags hain, jinhe CONNECT use nahi karta.

steps.title: Dashboard subscribe karta hai
steps.detail: Danish ka dashboard bhi connect hota hai, phir topic filters se subscribe karta hai. + wildcard bilkul ek level match karta hai, isliye home/+/temp har room ka temperature pakad leta hai. Dono QoS 1 par maange gaye hain. SUBACK har filter ke liye QoS 1 grant karta hai, usi order mein.

quiz.q: home/+/temp kaunsa topic match NAHI karta?
quiz.why: + ka matlab bilkul ek level. home/floor1/kitchen/temp mein beech mein do levels hain; home/# use match karta.

steps.title: Retained message
steps.desc: Last known value turant aa jaati hai
steps.detail: Kitchen sensor ne pehle RETAIN flag ke saath 21.5 publish kiya tha, isliye broker ne use topic ki last known value ke taur par rakh liya. Naya subscriber use turant paata hai, agli reading ka intezaar nahi karna padta. Is PUBLISH mein RETAIN bit set hai taaki dashboard ko pata chale ki yeh stored value hai, fresh nahi.

steps.title: QoS 1 ke saath PUBLISH
steps.desc: Sensor → broker → dashboard, har hop acknowledged
steps.detail: Living-room sensor packet ID 1 ke saath QoS 1 par 23.4 publish karta hai. QoS 1 ka matlab "at least once": broker use store karta hai aur PUBACK se jawab deta hai. Phir broker use har matching subscriber ko, yahan dashboard ko, apne packet ID ke saath forward karta hai, aur dashboard ke PUBACK ka intezaar karta hai. Har hop alag se acknowledge hota hai.

quiz.q: Sensor ka PUBLISH broker tak pahunch gaya, lekin PUBACK kho gaya. Sensor kya karta hai?
options: DUP flag ke saath PUBLISH dobara bhejta hai
quiz.why: PUBACK ke bina sender ko pata nahi chalta, isliye woh DUP=1 ke saath dobara bhejta hai. Isiliye QoS 1 duplicates deliver kar sakta hai.

steps.title: PINGREQ / PINGRESP
steps.detail: Sensor sirf tab report karta hai jab temperature badalta hai. 60 seconds tak kuch bhejne ko na ho to woh PINGREQ bhejta hai, sirf 2 bytes (0xC0 0x00), aur broker PINGRESP (0xD0 0x00) se jawab deta hai. Isse prove hota hai ki dono ends aur beech ka path zinda hai, aur ghar ke router ki NAT entry expire nahi hoti.

steps.title: Last will
steps.desc: Sensor gayab; broker uski taraf se bolta hai
steps.detail: Sensor ki battery khatam ho jaati hai. Woh kabhi DISCONNECT nahi bhejta, to broker intezaar karta hai. 90 s (1.5 × keep alive) tak koi packet na aane par woh connection chhod deta hai aur sensor ka will, home/livingroom/status par "offline", retained publish karta hai. Dashboard sensor ko offline dikhata hai. Clean DISCONNECT will ko discard kar deta.

quiz.q: Broker client ka last will kab publish karta hai?
options: Jab connection DISCONNECT ke bina kho jaaye
quiz.why: Will unexpected loss ke liye hai: timeouts, toote hue connections. Polite DISCONNECT use cancel kar deta hai.

outro.title: Publish, subscribe, survive
outro.text: Sensor aur dashboard ne kabhi seedhe ek doosre se baat nahi ki. Broker ne topics match kiye, naye aane walon ke liye last value rakhi, har QoS 1 hop acknowledge kiya, aur sensor ke gayab hone par uska last will bola.
facts: CONNECT, CONNACK, SUBSCRIBE, SUBACK, PUBLISH, PUBACK, PINGREQ, PINGRESP

reconnect.name: Broker unreachable: persistent session
reconnect.summary: Dashboard ka connection toot jaata hai, woh Clean Session 0 ke saath reconnect karta hai aur uske liye queue hue messages paata hai.

steps.title: Pings ka jawab nahi aata
steps.desc: Broker tak ka path toot jaata hai
steps.detail: Dashboard (client ID dashboard-danish) persistent session use karta hai: woh Clean Session = 0 ke saath connect hua tha aur QoS 1 par subscribe kiya tha. Phir Danish ka internet connection gir jaata hai. Uske PINGREQ ko PINGRESP nahi milta, isliye timeout ke baad client connection ko dead maan leta hai.

steps.title: Broker messages queue karta hai
steps.desc: Session broker par zinda rehta hai
steps.detail: Is beech sensor publish karta rehta hai. Kyunki dashboard ka session persistent hai aur subscription QoS 1 hai, broker har matching message ko phenkne ke bajaye uske liye store kar leta hai.
facts: Aam taur par queue nahi hote

steps.title: Backoff ke saath retry
steps.desc: Line down rehne tak SYNs fail hote hain
steps.detail: Client library connection retry karti hai, har baar zyada der ruk kar (2 s, 4 s, 8 s…) taaki hazaaron devices wapas aa rahe broker par toot na padein. Internet wapas aane tak yeh SYNs kahin nahi pahunchte.
facts: Reconnect storm se bachne ke liye

steps.title: Session present
steps.detail: Line wapas aa gayi. Client wahi client ID aur Clean Session = 0 ke saath reconnect karta hai. CONNACK Session Present = 1 ke saath aata hai: broker ke paas abhi bhi subscriptions aur queue hue messages hain, isliye client ko dobara subscribe karne ki zaroorat bhi nahi.

quiz.q: Agar client Clean Session = 1 ke saath reconnect karta, to 2 queue hue messages ka kya hota?
options: Purane session ke saath phenk diye jaate
quiz.why: Clean Session = 1 broker ko kehta hai ki purani session state discard kar do, queue hue messages aur subscriptions samet.

steps.title: Queue hue messages deliver hue
steps.desc: Dono readings aati hain, phir PUBACKs
steps.detail: Broker turant do stored PUBLISH packets order mein bhejta hai, aur client har ek ko acknowledge karta hai. Danish ka graph bina koi reading khoye gap bhar leta hai.

outro.title: Kuch nahi khoya
outro.text: Kyunki session persistent tha aur subscription QoS 1 use karti thi, broker ne client ke door rehte messages rakhe. Reconnect par Session Present = 1 ne client ko bataya ki uski subscriptions abhi bhi hain.

open-broker.name: Anonymous open broker
open-broker.summary: Scanner default settings par chhode gaye broker ke har topic ko padh leta hai; login zaroori karne se woh ruk jaata hai.

steps.title: Anonymous CONNECT accept hua
steps.detail: Internet devices ke search engines port 1883 par hazaaron brokers list karte hain. Scanner is broker se bina username ya password ke connect hota hai. Broker default settings ke saath install hua tha, jo anonymous clients allow karti hain, isliye woh CONNACK 0: accepted se jawab deta hai.

steps.title: SUBSCRIBE #
steps.detail: Scanner # par subscribe karta hai, yaani har topic. Retained messages ek saath aa jaate hain: room temperatures, lekin home/frontdoor/lock = unlocked bhi, jo chor ko kaam ki baat batata hai. Agar broker allow karta, to scanner devices ko commands bhi publish kar sakta tha.
facts: Commands bhi publish ho sakte the

quiz.q: Kaunsi setting is attacker ko CONNECT par hi rok deti?
options: Username aur password zaroori karna (aur har topic par ACLs)
quiz.why: Anonymous access band karo, TLS par credentials zaroori karo, aur ACLs lagao taaki har client sirf apne topics dekhe.

steps.title: Defence: login zaroori karo
steps.detail: Danish broker theek karta hai: anonymous access band, har client ke liye password, per-topic ACLs, aur port 8883 par TLS taaki passwords clear mein na jaayein. Wahi anonymous CONNECT ab CONNACK return code 5, Not authorized, paata hai, aur broker connection close kar deta hai.

outro.title: Broker ko lock karo
outro.text: Anonymous access wala MQTT broker har message, aur aksar control, internet par kisi ko bhi de deta hai. TLS par credentials zaroori karo, per-topic ACLs lagao, aur agar zaroori na ho to broker ko publicly expose mat karo.
